title: JB MDL comes to rescue during at-home baby delivery
description: In honor of the Month of the Military Child, the joint base came to the rescue of a family during an unexpected at-home baby delivery on Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst, N.J., April 28, 2023. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Simonne Barker)
keywords: JB MDL), AMC, USAF, #MonthoftheMilitaryChild, joint-force, at-homedelivery
